Game Overview

In Christmas Lollipop 2, the core idea is straightforward: embark on a festive adventure in Christmas Lollipop 2, a charming 2D platformer. Traverse eight challenging levels, collecting lollipops while dodging cunning foes. Master the double jump to soar over obstacles, and time your moves to find the exit. Can you make it through this winter wonderland?
